text:
Nadia (Product): Quick update — tomorrow 09:30 PT we are GA-ing Conductor: a hosted orchestration bundle for streaming + multi-tool pipelines. New stable endpoint: /v3/conductor-run. This enables coordinated tool execution, explicit slot reservations, and deterministic retries. GA is opt-in this week for partner customers; we will open to all in phased waves next month. Please read the GA notes before testing. :sparkles:
Ethan (Eng-API): Canary plan: 09:30026-05-05 start in us-east1 with 50 orgs. We'll monitor per-route latency, tool-exec duration, and orchestration error rates. No forced migration for v1/v2 clients. Canary keys issued via canary-service.
Riley (DevEx): Quick try-it-out (curl):
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v3/conductor-run \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_CANARY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"pipeline":[{"step":"parse","model":"small-nlp"},{"step":"lookup","tool":"kv_get","args":{"key":"user:123"}},{"step":"compose","model":"conductor-std"}],"input":"Write a short summary for user 123"}'
```
Riley (DevEx): JS SDK example:
```js
const run = await client.conductor.run({ pipeline, input: 'Hello' });
run.on('event', e => console.log(e.type, e.data));
```
Ethan (Eng-API): Notes for integrators: conductor enforces ordered tool semantics and exposes slot tokens to prevent double-invocation; tool callbacks are delivered as separate stream events. Watch for backpressure — clients should honor windowed ACKs.
Deploy-Bot: [deploy] conductor-ga-start service=hosted-conductor region=us-east1 at 2026-05-05T09:30:00Z :rocket:
Sam (SRE): SRE note: new SLAs for Conductor GA: p50 < 90ms, p95 < 400ms for orchestration overhead. Canary will page if orchestration-error-rate > 0.4% for 5m or tool-exec median > 2s over baseline. Please add synthetics that exercise multi-step pipelines.
Billing-Bot: Billing change: Conductor introduces exec-units for tool invocations (1 exec-unit per non-trivial tool call). During GA exec-units are free for beta partners; production pricing and telemetry will roll out after GA. Internal billing doc: https://redwood.internal/billing/conductor-ga (do not share externally).
Infra-Bot: Default per-route quota for earliest GA orgs: 10 req/s steady, burst 60. If you need sustained parallel pipelines raise a request in #ops-requests with org id + qps.
Nadia (Product): Were hosting a 30m GA walk-through + live troubleshooting session 10:15 PT tomorrow. RSVP: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/conductor-ga-walkthrough. Drop questions here beforehand or bring them to the session. :pray:
